newsitem.title: CHINA: China interbank market rates (CHIBOR) mixed.
newsitem.headline: China interbank market rates (CHIBOR) mixed.

text.p: Following is the China Interbank Offered Rate (CHIBOR) for Thursday issued by the official Xinhua news agency on behalf of the People's Bank of China, the central bank.
The figures represent weighted averages and not closing prices and are annual percentage rates.
Turnover fell to 1.19 billion yuan from 1.482 billion yuan with the 60-day contract the most actively traded.

Traders said trading was dull mainly due to the prevailing cautious sentiment after the central bank banned state banks trading on the stock market and state debt repurchase and spot secondary market.
All financial institutions, the state-run banks and non-banking financial institutions including securities houses, have become reluctant to trade, they said.
"They are waiting for possible new government measures to regulate the markets," one traders said.
Traders said the caution would make the interbank rates move narrowly in slow trading in the short term.
